name: zmath_vec3_elevation_angle_between_points
description: zMath_Vec3_ElevationAngleBetweenPoints returns the elevation angle between two points using the recovered zMath delta convention.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this trigonometric helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath vector/source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja HLIL still renders the fpatan result as an int32_t temporary, so functional evidence is tied to the inspected x87 assembly and native smoke coverage.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x474d90 validates delta.x=pointA.x-pointB.x, delta.y=pointB.y-pointA.y, delta.z=pointA.z-pointB.z, horizontal=sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.z*delta.z), and fpatan(horizontal, delta.y) returning the float in st0.
The native zMath smoke verifies a representative 3-4-5 horizontal/elevation pair returns pi/4 using the public fastcall helper.
